open_button.tip: Open the file in the path field.
open_button.what: Opens the Maya file in the path field as the current scene (unsaved changes are lost).
examples: Pick a saved base scene and click Open to start from it.
Open a saved test scene with ROM animation.

import_button.tip: Import the file in the path field.
import_button.what: Imports the file in the path field into the current scene.
examples: Pick a saved ctrl shape file, click Import.
Import a saved set of locators you use on every rig.

reference_button.tip: Reference the file in the path field.
reference_button.what: Brings the file in the path field into the scene as a reference.
examples: Reference a model to rig on top without importing it.
Reference the latest model to check it against the rig.

save_button.tip: Save the scene to the shelf.
save_button.what: Saves the whole scene under the name in the field, with a preview image.
examples: Save a clean starting scene for a new character.
save_button.details: cShelves.save_file(name) + create_image() for the thumbnail, then refreshes the list.

export_sel_button.tip: Export the selection to the shelf.
export_sel_button.what: Exports only the selected objects under the name in the field, with a preview image.
examples: Select a ctrl set, name it "face_ctrls", Export Sel.
Export a nice ctrl shape library to reuse on other rigs.
export_sel_button.details: cShelves.export_sel(name) exports the selection only, with a thumbnail.

explorer_button.what: Opens the folder where the shelf files are saved, in the Windows explorer.
examples: Click it to copy shelf files to another machine.
Delete old shelf files you do not need.
